study.question: Does the real-versus-count-matched-shifted historical feedback placement effect, and its interaction with task-conditioned residual routing, survive removal of the history-wide common action centroid before the inherited low-precision match-summary contraction?
study.hypothesis: r0050 click-minus-shift click-AUC differences are 0.0020952989151835 (task) and 0.0027627971265839 (shared); interaction task-minus-shared = -0.0006674982114004. These are one-seed results, not independent repetitions or significance. The common RMS is computed from both action partitions; it retains feedback information. All four diagnostics were not_requested. The helper adds a shared history action centroid before bf16 rounding, even though raw/scaled match coefficients are block-centered. Constant terms cancel only in ideal arithmetic; cancellation leakage is unmeasured. r0048 fixed-direction, r0049 opposite-radius, and r0050 common-radius trajectories separate direction/radius from placement imperfectly; none beats the imported incumbent. r0024 zero-action and context replacement losses, r0034 item-duplicate losses, r0045 residual and r0046 reflection trajectories prevent interpreting a failed projection as global feedback uselessness. No execution failures appear in the supplied trajectory index; unlisted campaigns are not local evidence. Mechanism hypothesis: at a shared symmetric-RMS radius, placement of the two feedback strata relative to target-match coefficients carries useful signal beyond common-centroid numerical leakage. Removing the common centroid should preserve much of the placement gap. This is an attribution/numerical robustness control, not a new architecture or a claim that all historical actions are removed.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version primary section 4.3 and Dice section 5.2 read. Inherit unnormalized target-conditioned local activation and Dice through the local four-task adaptation. Proposed change removes a mathematically null common mean only at a stopped synthetic summary consumer; it is not in the paper and no originality claim is made.

Pinned UniRank benchmark forward lines 123-170 inspected: task masks initialize per-task sequence hubs and repeated categorical/sequence/task exchange. Our inherited residual-bank readout is a different task-conditioning mechanism; no hub architecture adopted. Original paper paper:infnet is provenance-only in the registry; equivalence and priority remain unverified.

Original 70-slot primary/30-slot auxiliary Dice populations and gradient ownership
Unchanged history-wise click/rotated-click group counts, action means, shared symmetric RMS, fixed dense axis, and target-match coefficients
Observed pooled actions and aligned ordinal summaries; local match-action derivatives remain blocked
Full four-task outputs, frozen host training loss and evaluation protocol
study.proposed_difference: Add summary_common_mean={retained,removed}; submitted cells use removed. Replace only fixed-direction synthetic group means M+(g-p)Ru by (g-p)Ru before dtype conversion, with zero output for empty/single occupied groups. M, p, R and ancestor canonical means are still computed, preserving reduction order and providing a retained source bridge. Only stopped action coordinates in match rows 0/4 consume the change; other consumers and original masks are untouched. Cross real versus within-block count-preserving shifted feedback placement with task versus shared residual routing in four standalone modules. Compare each cell to its r0050 counterpart for a mean-removal contrast.
predictions: At a fixed parameter state and in exact arithmetic, match rows 0/4 before and after removal agree because every block coefficient sums to zero; all nonmatch/action and item paths remain unchanged. Any observed forward discrepancy is numerical and must be reported before attributing training effects.

Real placement will retain higher validation click AUC than shifted placement under both routing choices if the previous gap is not explained by common-centroid leakage. Report D_task, D_shared and D_task-D_shared explicitly; previous interaction is negative and task conditioning must not be claimed to amplify placement utility.

Mean-removal changes should be smaller than the approximately 0.0021/0.0028 placement differences. Predeclared descriptive guardrails: absolute AUC change <=0.0005 per matched old/new cell and placement gaps >0.001 in both routing cells. These are decision thresholds, not significance or equivalence tests.

Expected 32129765 parameters, 31793216 embedding and 336549 dense in every cell; wall cost should remain near r0050 387-401 seconds/unit. Measure actual GPU/wall/train/inference/memory cost and all four tasks; auxiliary quality is not presumed preserved.
falsifiers: Common-mean removal collapses or reverses the real-placement gap, or changes matched cell AUC by more than 0.0005: weaken the numerical-robustness account and inspect precision/centering before further mechanism claims.
Any change to raw input visibility/masks, action pools, item summaries, original ordinal summaries, Dice populations/buffers, local gradient ownership or parameter counts invalidates isolation.

Nonfinite outputs/gradients, mask leakage, dependence on padding actions or current target action, mismatched donor radii at a fixed state, or failure of retained-mode source bridge invalidates the implementation.
A routing interaction failing to repeat across paired seeds is preliminary; four new one-seed cells cannot establish repeated support or production causal availability.
alternative_explanations: BF16 quantization of values and coefficient zero-sum error can interact with the common centroid, radius and task-bank optimization; this is exactly the numerical nuisance being examined.

Removing the centroid changes per-event energy and eliminates a fallback mean in one-group histories. Their centered match contraction is ideally zero, but low-precision deviations may affect training.
Shared and task routing match instantiated parameters and bank execution, but differ in gradient sharing/effective function class.

R remains action-dependent, click membership itself is historical feedback, and observed pools/ordinal action values remain live. No result identifies utility beyond every feedback path or proves embedding content unnecessary.
Same-seed adaptive validation selection, residual-bank conditioning and one-pass optimization can explain modest differences. Existing related branches are mechanism contrasts, not seed repetitions.
Offline released feedback maturation and category/brand auxiliary attribution limit applicability to production timing.
